title: The Signature Campus Event Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Public event listings, dates, venues, and registration links. The Campus Event Database lists public campus events with dates, times, venues, descriptions, and registration links where published. Events are categorized (academic, cultural, career, social) and records expire after the event date. The Signature side adds planning checklists for students organizing their own public events.
capabilities: List public events with dates, venues, and registration links
Categorize events by type for browsing
Expire records automatically after event dates
Provide planning checklists for student organizers
Link events to hosting organizations

title: The Signature Campus Event Database — Safety, limits, and ecosystem
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout.
